question.text: What percentage of holders (by value) must approve the roll-over of non-convertible portions through postal ballot under Regulation 108?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Regulation 108, roll-over of the non-convertible portion requires approval from 75% of holders measured by value through a resolution by postal ballot. The Trap: 51% represents a simple majority, which applies to many corporate decisions but not to roll-over approval under Regulation 108. Note: The 75% threshold under Regulation 108 is measured by value of holdings, not by headcount of holders.
